screens.name: First boot and empty Hub
screens.summary: The browser shell starts, establishes its local profile, and presents the empty space directory.

screens.name: Space directory
screens.summary: The Hub lists local, owned, and joined spaces and exposes the account and create-space routes.

screens.name: Space home
screens.summary: A selected space renders its configured home with the floating action bar available over the content.

screens.name: Space actions and switching
screens.summary: The expanded floating action bar names the current space and lists every other account-directory space alongside renaming, sharing, sync, and appearance actions.

screens.name: Join and share ceremonies
screens.summary: Invite claim, accountless accreditation, share, and absent-space access states explain what will change and retain actionable Tonk navigation before authority moves.

screens.name: Invalid space route
screens.summary: The running shell keeps an invalid space identifier visible as a configuration error instead of silently returning to the Hub.

screens.name: Account choice
screens.summary: A provider-free profile can create an account, log in, choose a browser profile, or return to local Tonk.

screens.name: Create account
screens.summary: The account creation form collects an email and turns passkey cancellation, unsupported authenticators, and remote failures into distinct recovery steps.

screens.name: Log in with a passkey
screens.summary: The browser explains that a passkey ceremony will select the existing account before linking this profile.

screens.name: CLI authorization handoff
screens.summary: The browser names the waiting CLI device and requires explicit passkey approval or cancellation.

screens.name: Account settings
screens.summary: Account facts and management stay visible while pending email confirmation is named directly and authoritative edits remain disabled until account state is ready.

screens.name: Devices and revocation
screens.summary: The devices panel identifies this device, confirms revocation, and requires a refresh before retry when the result cannot be confirmed.

screens.name: Deletion review
screens.summary: The destructive confirmation enumerates exact scope, says when cancellation changed nothing, and treats a lost result as uncertain before retry.

screens.name: Activate account
screens.summary: An emailed activation link can be accepted on any device; damaged, expired, offline, and unknown failures each lead to a safe next step.

screens.name: Activation result
screens.summary: Successful and failed activation settle explicitly without exposing service response bodies, routes, or HTTP details.

screens.name: Command index and help
screens.summary: The command index, command help, and embedded guides expose the CLI's user-facing surface before any state changes.

screens.name: Space inventory and selection
screens.summary: Human and JSON listings identify local, owned, joined, and unresolved spaces while context rules select one for later commands.

screens.name: Space lifecycle
screens.summary: Creation, adoption, binding, removal, and home selection report what changed locally and what data remains.

screens.name: Account status and devices
screens.summary: Account commands report profile, attachment, customer, repository, and device authority without collapsing them into signed-in or signed-out.

screens.name: Browser login handoff
screens.summary: CLI login names the browser route, waiting state, cancellation boundary, and activation or recovery result.

screens.name: Status, pull, push, and auto-sync
screens.summary: Sync output distinguishes no upstream, synced, ahead, behind, diverged, unavailable, and unauthorized states.

screens.name: Invite, join, and revoke
screens.summary: Collaboration commands expose the authority being shared, the claimed space, remote choice, and later revocation result.

screens.name: Concepts, views, and data verbs
screens.summary: Schema-derived commands expose stable view anchors and entities, then render every matching presentation in browser-equivalent order and frame mode.

screens.name: Notation evaluation
screens.summary: Evaluation reports parse, analysis, match, commit, and sync outcomes for inline, file, and piped input.

screens.name: Blob and CSV transfer
screens.summary: Blob and transfer commands make content type, content address, input source, output destination, and partial failure explicit.

screens.name: Remote, identity, migration, telemetry, and update
screens.summary: Maintenance commands state their local and remote scope, confirmation boundary, privacy behavior, and recovery result.

verification.claim: Legacy account routes canonicalize without losing intent (Resolve).
Fresh Create yields one root/account/device and a pending customer (Settle).
Existing-email rejection has the decided credential policy and safe retry (Edge cases, suspected B-02).
Cancelling WebAuthn before a credential exists leaves account state unchanged (Cancel and interrupt).
Lost account-create response reconciles instead of creating a second account (Failure checkpoints).
Remote create followed by local attachment failure is recoverable through login (Cross a boundary).
Busy account actions cannot be abandoned into an unlabelled partial state (Cancel and interrupt, suspected B-04).
Every browser-create checkpoint has a deterministic restart outcome (Browser create checkpoints).
Missing and damaged activation links do no network/account work (Exit early).
Activation maps success, expired, service error, malformed body, and offline distinctly (Browser response contract).
Activation is single-submit and idempotent (Edge cases, suspected B-05).
Activation confirmed in another browser reaches the waiting one without a reload (Remain in flight).
The settings panel reflects an account the registration cluster created, in place (Settle).
The cluster answers about an address it has already been told about (Resolve).
The accountless browser reopens one onboarding identity (Simple case).
A customer waiting for email confirmation remains an account on every surface (Remain in flight).
Every browser account failure names the failed action, safe remaining state, and next step (Output, errors, and recovery).
Registered customer sees pending notice and resend recovery (Remain in flight).
Local-only space remains usable before activation and attaches afterward (Simple case).
Fresh-browser login links one device and survives restart (Settle).
Logout then same-account login reuses the device safely (Simple case).
Browser and CLI logout are local-first when provider detach fails (Settle).
Sign-out and different-account login select existing profiles without rebinding retained local work (Resolve).
Two browser accounts switch without leaking spaces or in-flight results (Settle).
verification.result: Automated in it_signs_into_another_account_without_rebinding_retained_local_spaces plus the worker stale-client regression.

verification.claim: Unconfigured and unhydrated account states are visible and recoverable (Resolve).
Suspended/unreachable customer does not hide local account or space state (Interactions).
Enter/blur/concurrent account renames have one defined result (Edge cases).
CLI status reports every local state without remote dependency (Resolve).
Settings geometry preserves one coherent Account/Devices surface (Settings presentation decision).
Linked browser approves a waiting CLI end to end (Simple case).
Unlinked browser creates/logs in before approving without losing callback (Resolve).
Browser decline reaches CLI promptly and commits no CLI authority (Exit early).
Ctrl-C during callback wait exits code 4 and stays signed out (Exit early).
SIGTERM/forced exit before approval leaves no resumable or remote state (Cancel and interrupt).
Missing/malformed callback query cannot authorize (Resolve).
Invalid callback payload installs no authority (Cross a boundary).
Crash after browser registration but before callback receipt reconciles one generation (Edge cases, suspected B-01).
Every post-callback native write has a safe fresh-process recovery (Open questions).
Account store failure is detected before approval where possible (Cancel and interrupt).
Hydration timeout settles logged in but unhydrated, then sync recovers (Settle).
Page-supplied deployment provider overrides CLI default safely (Edge cases).
Concurrent login/logout cannot create two active sessions or deadlock (Interactions).
Browser profile switch cannot authorize CLI from the wrong account (Cancel and interrupt).
Broken CLI stdout after URL/result does not replay authorization (Interactions).
HTTPS approval reaches loopback without relying on a cross-scheme POST body (Remain in flight).
CLI login reconciles pre-account spaces without changing their identity or hiding deferred invite rotation (Settle).
Missing or unsafe return redirects use a legible local fallback without changing the terminal outcome (Settle).
Device list identifies self separately from shared rows (Resolve).
Revoke deep link selects but does not authorize (Resolve).
Revoking another device denies later remote access and preserves unrelated/local state (Settle).
Self-revocation disables authority and leaves an escape path (Settle).
Partial revocation publication is visible and retryable (Remain in flight).
Exact hosted-space deletion removes only the reviewed owned subject (Settle).
Joined/missing/stale exact-space plans cannot widen deletion scope (Resolve).
Whole-account deletion releases exact owned scope and rotates deleted profile (Settle).
Wrong confirmation phrase, Cancel, and passkey rejection delete nothing (Exit early).
Lost/partial deletion response reconciles exact per-subject results (Remain in flight).
Deleted/revoked stale devices cannot recreate account or hosted space (Edge cases).
Adding a passkey does not leave an unexplained orphan on fact/publish failure (Cross a boundary).
Every command/subcommand is reachable through help and mapped to a journey (Inventory).
Help and usage errors create no profile/site/lock/telemetry mutation (Exit early).
Space selection precedence is flag, environment, nearest binding, then none (Resolve).
Human/JSON/notation/CSV/HTML/blob stdout stays free of diagnostics (Interactions).
--verbose expands the chain without changing product result (Resolve).
Dry-run never commits or touches remote (Exit early).
Local commit followed by push failure reports committed-local and retries safely (Settle).
Lost remote response is reconciled before mutation replay (Recovery rules).
Broken stdout after commit cannot cause mutation replay (Edge cases).
SIGINT/SIGTERM at each command-family boundary has explicit state (Cancel and interrupt).
Locked, read-only/full, malformed, and unsupported local state fail safely (Error families).
CI discovers every intended CLI test, including native-only exceptions (Open questions).
Space list distinguishes empty, registered, data-only, missing-data, and account-listed state (Resolve).
Local-only creation is atomic or recoverable at site/registry/binding checkpoints (Cross a boundary).
Signed-in creation retains ownership locally while service is pending/unavailable (Remain in flight).
space new --site adopts only a valid existing site and never overwrites (Resolve).
Use/unbind changes only exact selection pointers (Settle).
Local remove decline changes nothing; confirmed remove has recoverable checkpoints (Cross a boundary).
--keep-data unregisters without deleting and later adoption restores it (Settle).
Linking local-only to account is generation/subject-idempotent (Cross a boundary).
Link refuses signed-out, joined, foreign-owned, and mismatched-upstream targets safely while treating the same-account owner as resumable (Exit early).
Account directory list/pull and the FABB switcher handle duplicates, offline cache, missing/stale and exact subjects (Space-switcher and absent-space presentation decision).
Account-space pull crash cannot leave invisible or duplicate replica (Edge cases).
Hub confirmation removes its exact local space while cancellation remains an exit-early path (Settle).
verification.result: Pass (local, 2026-08-29): the focused real-browser regression completed every step against the built product.

verification.claim: Status reports R0–R6 without mutation (Settle).
Push handles concurrent head and lost response without lost update/duplicate commit (Remain in flight).
Pull does not destructively resolve ahead/diverged and recovers before ref update (Cancel and interrupt).
Sharing a space with no account raises registration in place and finishes the interrupted share (Cross a boundary).
Invite remote/base/shortening variants produce the intended URL without leaking authority (Resolve).
Join/claim is atomic across claim, site, registry, binding, remote setup (Cross a boundary).
Accountless claim survives later account link and second-device recovery (Edge cases).
Revocation denies later remote work without falsifying retained local state (Settle).
The share stack remains aligned and contained for a long member roster (Share-menu presentation decision).
Concept and all view kinds round-trip through list/show/render (Inventory).
view add --home and space home are atomically visible as browser home (Open questions).
Assert/update/no-op/retract preserve untouched fields and handle concurrent claims (Inventory).
Eval input modes and output modes agree (Resolve).
Render/blob/export outputs handle missing targets and output failure safely (Inventory).
Import is row-safe and retryable after malformed/partial failure (Cross a boundary).
Space AGENTS claim round-trips default file, named file, and stdin (Inventory).
View creation exposes the stable anchor and derived entity before later commands need either identity (Inventory).
Headless rendering matches the browser's multi-view frame boundary (Inventory).
Carry/account migrations are idempotent and crash-recoverable (Inventory).
Telemetry precedence and privacy are stable (Interactions).
Update download/verify/swap rolls back safely on interruption (Cross a boundary).
Every route family mounts exactly one correct top-level element (Resolve).
First/returning/offline boot has bounded visible recovery (Remain in flight).
Service-worker update never mixes asset generations (Cross a boundary).
Account gate permits provider-free/local use and blocks only authority-specific work (Exit early).
Profile switch/revoke/delete invalidates stale DOM authority (Remain in flight).
Blank/configured/invalid home and inspector routes settle visibly and interactively (Settle).
Deployment misconfiguration fails closed with diagnostics (Edge cases).
Async custom element disconnect cannot repaint a later route/profile (Cancel and interrupt).
Busy/errors/confirmations are keyboard, touch, and screen-reader usable (Interactions).
Compact and zoomed layouts retain the full interaction (Edge cases).
Boot and transient space loading use one accessible, destination-neutral treatment (Loading presentation decision).
